notes.title: Update ver1.0.2
notes.content:
Thank you for enjoying "Moonless Moon".
We have updated to version 1.0.2.

Fixes  
  
 Typographical errors have been corrected.

notes.title: Video & Image Sharing Guidelines
notes.content:
Please adhere to the following guidelines when posting gameplay videos and images
related to the full version of "Moonless Moon".

Do not use excessive editing or processing that prevents others from correctly grasping the content of the game.
Do not extract individual elements included in this game, such as background music or character images.
Do not redistribute for profit. However, the normal monetization of videos on sites like YouTube is allowed.
Do not combine it with content that is contrary to public order and morals, or combine it with illegal information.
Do not make posts that include modifications to this game, data mining results, etc.
Do not reprint videos or screenshots created by third parties without permission.

This game includes songs managed by JASRAC and NexTone, so you may receive a notice of a copyright claim
if you post a video that contains these songs on YouTube.
However, as long as you adhere to our guidelines, you do not need to delete the video.

*These guidelines may be updated at any time without notice.
Please check here for the latest version of these guidelines before you post content.

Last Updated: Aug 8, 2024

Here are some materials you can use for your submission
https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fo/7bcp6g3kix7m2vwfwzxli/AGf-QEwZYv3lL2sagQbbNYY?rlkey=42ex9ofjw0n82e6co0v875hos&dl=0

notes.title: Demo available during Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Moonless Moon, set for release in 2024, will be participating in the Steam Next Fest, starting on June 10th 10:00 (PT).

The demo will be playable on both Windows and Mac, and you'll be able to play through the prologue section of the game.

Please look forward to trying out the demo!
